title: Real-Time Object Detection from ISRO Satellite Imagery
description: Trained and benchmarked multiple YOLO model variants for real-time detection of objects in real satellite images sourced from ISRO datasets, optimizing the inference pipeline for real-time performance on remote-sensing imagery.
highlights: Trained and benchmarked multiple YOLO model variants (v8, v11, v26) for real-time detection of objects in real satellite images sourced from ISRO datasets.
Optimized the inference pipeline for real-time performance on remote-sensing imagery, balancing detection accuracy and speed across model versions.

title: Real-Time Satellite Image Denoising & Enhancement
description: Designed and implemented denoising models to remove noise from real-time satellite imagery, improving image clarity for downstream object-detection tasks.
highlights: Designed and implemented denoising models to remove noise from real-time satellite imagery, improving image clarity for downstream object-detection tasks.
Applied preprocessing and enhancement techniques to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of real satellite and remote-sensing data.

title: BDH-YOLO26: Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Aircraft Detection
description: Research project integrating Dragon Hatchling (BDH) architecture concepts with YOLO26 for accurate aircraft detection in high-resolution satellite images.
highlights: Explores hybrid BDH + YOLO26 architectures for aircraft detection in high-resolution satellite imagery.
Builds on ISRO research into efficient large-scale satellite image analysis.

title: COVID-19 & Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-Ray Images
description: Built a 4-class deep-learning classifier (COVID-19, Pneumonia, Viral Infection, Normal) for real-time chest X-ray screening, with image preprocessing and Grad-CAM-based visualization.
highlights: Built a 4-class deep-learning classifier (COVID-19, Pneumonia, Viral Infection, Normal) for real-time chest X-ray screening.
Applied image preprocessing and accuracy-based evaluation, with Grad-CAM support for visualizing model attention.

title: Real-Time Labour Booking Platform for Farmers
description: A real-time web platform enabling farmers to book agricultural laborers on demand, with live availability status and instant booking confirmation.
highlights: Built a real-time web platform enabling farmers to book agricultural laborers on demand, with live availability status and instant booking confirmation.
Designed a responsive UI and booking workflow to streamline labor discovery and scheduling for farmers in rural areas.
Written up as "Real-Time Web-Based Marketplace for On-Demand Matching of Agricultural Labor" — accepted for presentation at ICCSECD 2026.

title: Batsman Performance Analysis using Machine Learning
description: Machine learning based analysis and visualization of batsman performance data.
highlights: Applied machine learning and data-visualization techniques to analyze batsman performance data.
